app_notes: This feature adds a single pure function ResourcePrefix(value string) (string, bool) to the existing internal/id/resource.go file, along with table-driven tests in internal/id/resource_test.go. No new modules, services, or dependencies are introduced. The function iterates the seven existing Prefix* constants and delegates to HasResourceShape for each, returning the prefix and true on match, or empty string and false otherwise. No API endpoints are added, so no auth or error contracts apply.
